text:
Where do I come from? Seek the most dreadful,
rugged path:
the tracks of bloodied feet
upon hard rock;
the remnants of a soul torn to shreds
among sharp brambles
will tell you the way
that leads to my cradle.

Where am I going? Cross the darkest,
saddest wasteland,
a valley of eternal snows and eternal,
melancholy mists.
Where a solitary stone stands
without an inscription,
where oblivion dwells,
there my grave will be.

translation.title: Rhyme LXVI: Where Do I Come From?
